projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Roads 2027-2034 (Work Plan Roadways)
projects.notes: Everything in the layer is planned (8-year construction work plan, federal fiscal years 2027-2037 in PROGRAM_FED_YR). No status field; T_LET_DATE_YEAR/T_LET_DATE_MONTH exist but were null in the sample, so PROGRAM_FED_YR is the schedule. Work codes 86:RIGHT OF WAY and 91:UTILITIES are separate job pieces that mark right-of-way acquisition. County is a number (COUNTY_NO), not a name. ODOT republishes under a new service name each October (..._2026to2033, ..._2027to2034).

projects.name: ODOT 8-Year Work Plan Bridges 2027-2034 (Work Plan Bridges)
projects.notes: Bridges in the same 8-year plan; WORK_CODE uses the same numeric codes as the roads layer (text is in the roads layer's T_PROJ_WORK_DESC). PROG_FED_YR 2027-2037.
